decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed amendments to Buildings 8 and 9 at Chiswick Park are recommended for approval as they are considered to be an acceptable form of development and to comply with policies ENV-B.1.1, E 2.3, ENV-P1.7 and ENV-P 2.5 of the Councils Unitary Development Plan. The amended proposals are not considered to be detrimental to the amenity of nearby residents, and are considered to preserve the original building and to improve the energy efficiency of the proposed buildings
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - The level of noise from the plant shall be inaudible when assessed from the nearest noise sensitive receptor. The level of noise emitted from the plant shall not be less than 10dB(A) below the existing noise levels (LAeq) when measured over any 24 hour period from the nearest noise sensitive receptor.
description: Amendments to the approved details of buildings 8 and 9 (00248/D/P53) incorporating revised louvre system, high level canopy fire escapes roof top plant external enclosures landscaping atria internal core layout and parking.
